# VortexOne

> VortexOne is a small, founder-run back-office desk based in Islamabad, Pakistan, working US business hours (Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern) for US clients. It runs two specialist service lines ("files"): real estate virtual assistant work for agents, teams and investors, and Xactimate insurance supplementing for roofing and water-damage restoration contractors. Pricing is quoted per workload after a 15-minute call. VortexOne prepares estimates and documentation for contractors; it does not negotiate with insurance carriers, represent homeowners or act as a public adjuster.

## File 01 — Real estate VA
- [Real Estate VA](/real-estate-va/): MLS listing management, transaction coordination, CRM management, lead follow-up and cold calling, social media, fix-and-flip support, web development, SEO, Meta ads, lead generation (on request).

## File 02 — Insurance supplementing
- [Insurance Supplementing](/insurance-supplementing/): Xactimate estimates, supplement packages, photo and documentation review, claim status tracking.

## Key pages
- [Pricing](/pricing/): Part-time (20 hrs/week), Full-time (40 hrs/week) and Custom scope; contact for pricing. Payment by Wise or Payoneer.
- [Savings calculator](/savings-calculator/): estimate the monthly cost of an in-house assistant.
- [How we work](/how-we-work/): onboarding, daily written reports, communication, security.
- [About](/about/): the founder and why the desk runs two files.
